headword: {書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}

conjugation.prefix: {書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}

definitions.explanation: The process of drafting and preparing official or business documents. A routine part of office work in Japan.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}に{時間|じかん}がかかった。
{書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}は{今週中|こんしゅうちゅう}に{終|お}わらせてください。
examples.english: Please finish the paperwork by the end of this week.

examples.japanese: {確定|かくてい}{申告|しんこく}の{書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}を{税理士|ぜいりし}に{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: I asked a tax accountant to prepare my tax return documents.

notes:
USAGE:
A common compound noun in business and administrative contexts. Can be used with する to function as a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}をする (to prepare documents)
- {書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}に{時間|じかん}がかかる (document preparation takes time)
- {書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}を{依頼|いらい}する (to request document preparation)
- {書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}{能力|のうりょく} (document preparation skills)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {事務|じむ}{作業|さぎょう}: office work, clerical tasks — broader, includes filing, data entry, etc.
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}: document creation — more formal; {文書|ぶんしょ} emphasizes the written text itself
